ridge.lambda_policy: BOTH lambdas solved by BOTH solvers and scored on CAL4 and DEV5; no lambda selection by pilot; robust is no longer diagnostic-only
ridge.normalization: source-equal-weight gated loss; Z = mean_c ||g*Y_c||^2/n_c + 1e-12; ridge = lambda/(||A_Q1||_F^2 + 1e-12); identical to R1
ridge.solver_original: verbatim R1 FP32 Gram/RHS + FP32 eigh + clamp_min(0) + column filter g_j^2/(g_j^2*mu + ridge); recomputed at both lambdas for the identity gate and out-of-row-space measurement
ridge.solver_stable: F64 accumulation of Gram/RHS from raw X/R; weighted thin-SVD sample-space solve c_ji = g_j^2 s_i (U^T Rw)_ji/(g_j^2 s_i^2 + ridge), D = Vh^T C, ALL min(N,d) modes used (no truncation); independent F64 eigh cross-check on the F64-formed normal system; F64 normal relative residual; D in CAL row space by construction
ridge.certificates: stable cross-check rel_l2 <= 1e-7 AND stable full-sample-space out-of-space rel_fro <= 1e-10 enforced by raise at every site and lambda; F64 tolerances are condition-number-aware (kappa ~ g^2*smax^2/rho up to ~1e7, eps64*kappa ~ 1e-9..1e-8); energy outside the R1-Gram-criterion CAL subspace (mu=sv^2 > 1e-6*max(mu), equivalently sv > 1e-3*smax; D_out_of_calgram_rel_fro) is a diagnostic for both solvers and the basis for the original-D artifact measurement and omega — the identical basis definition used by R1 omega_source/gram_numerical_rank, so omega is comparable by construction (with rho ~ 1e-7 even F64 noise-floor modes contribute ~1e-9 relative, so the CAL-subspace quantity is not tightly certified); selfcheck_v2 ill-conditioned test (rho in (1e-8,1e-6), rank-deficient wide X constructed in F64 so numerical rank == mathematical rank 6; the original FP32 path receives FP32-rounded copies mirroring R1's data path) requires stable-vs-raw-F64 probe rel <= 1e-7, cross-check <= 1e-7, full-space oos <= 1e-12, D_numerical_rank <= 6, and original-FP32 CAL-subspace leak > 1e-4
ridge.export: actually-tested BF16 matrices saved and SHA-recorded: A_free_orig_main = BF16(A_Q1 + D_orig_main_FP32), A_free_stable_main = BF16(A_Q1 + D_stable_main_F64->FP32), A_free_stable_rob likewise, plus recomputed BF16-raw-uint16 D_orig_main; math lift uses the unrounded FP32/F64 sum exactly as R1

precision: TF32 off; native BF16 addmm/tanh-GELU boundaries; FP32 math lift; BF16 cache/gate replay (cache=BF16(y0-u0@a), base=BF16(u1@a+cache), gated=BF16(base*g), target=BF16(y1*g)); FP64 error reductions; stable ridge accumulates in F64 from raw X/R; ICC attribution in F64 from the same BF16 operands; small-M replay excludes full-M residual writeback (proxy boundary, not full-path equivalence)
readouts: per-site: original-vs-R1 BF16(D) SHA identity and per-source SSE max relative difference; original D out-of-R1-criterion-CAL-subspace energy (both lambdas); stable certificates (cross-check, normal residual, rank, omega basis); source-equal-weight current-gate absolute SSE/MSE and paired change vs Q1 for 10 arms, CAL4/DEV5 separate; increment-target and full-Y normalization auxiliary; math lift and BF16 replay separate; ICC F64 decomposition (stage-1 propagated / stage-2 native-h / cross) with identity residual and BF16 pred-rounding diagnostic; ICC zero-increment control; omega_stable per DEV source vs R1 reference omega (identical R1 Gram basis criterion); checkpoint-file SHA re-verified per expert at runtime

r0_verification_inherited.note: Gate-sharing and capture identity were R0-verified for the frozen R1 scope and are re-asserted at runtime per expensive site by runner_recheck (torch.equal across CAL sources); job fails loudly if violated.
r0_verification_inherited.gate_identity: bitwise equal across all 9 sources at high/0,4,19,34 step1 and low/4,19,34 step3 (R0, job-bound evidence in the R1 publication)

pre_registered_rules.identity_gate: recomputed BF16(D_orig_main) SHA must equal both reference_r1 JSON and r1_reference.ridgeD_bf16_sha256; on mismatch record identity_warning and continue with the recomputed original (no abort); identity comparisons then treated as suspect in the report
pre_registered_rules.certificates: stable cross-check rel > 1e-7 or stable full-sample-space out-of-space rel > 1e-10 at any site/lambda -> raise; job fails; no partial summary promoted
pre_registered_rules.substantial_change: |source-equal-weight paired mean_rel_change| > 0.01 on DEV5 math-lift MSE; reporting threshold only, selects nothing
pre_registered_rules.H_artifact: supported iff stable-main DEV5 change within 1% of Q1 (or better) at >= 4 of 6 sites AND original D out-of-R1-criterion-CAL-subspace rel >= 0.10 at those sites
pre_registered_rules.H_overfit: supported iff stable-main DEV5 still degrades > 1% at >= 4 of 6 sites
pre_registered_rules.mixed: otherwise report per-site numbers and shares without a binary verdict
pre_registered_rules.lambda_policy: both lambdas reported for both solvers regardless of outcome; no post-hoc preference
pre_registered_rules.icc_policy: stage shares descriptive only; no new ICC claim beyond the decomposition and the frozen-config comparison
pre_registered_rules.retention: all results including unfavorable configurations retained in output/; no post-hoc site/lambda/threshold selection

limitations: CAL4 already used for the original Q1 fit; DEV5 are exposed development sources. Source-out readouts are development screening, NOT blind confirmation.

About 500 matched CAL rows for a 5120x5120 D: severely underdetermined even with the exact solve; rank <= 517/523 is a bound, not identification. omega bounds the explainable DEV fraction; a within-1% DEV result favors the artifact explanation but does not prove generalization.
R1b changes numerics only, not the registered objective; if H_overfit holds, R1's qualitative conclusion survives with corrected certificates.
Small-M paired-row math lift and BF16 cache/gate replay only; no full-M residual writeback, no free-trajectory or video evidence.
No 80-site landscape rerun; the published R1 landscape stands (its gate_fro2 field was diagnostic-only and consumed by no score).
Chipmunk author arm not scored (full-M proxy groups missing); recorded MISSING_ASSET, deferred to R2.
ICC evaluated only at the frozen svd_r512 two-residual config on six sites; decomposition is attribution, not a new configuration search.
Gate sharing re-asserted at runtime per expensive site; job fails loudly if violated, no silent fallback.
F64 SVD/eigh deterministic on the pinned node/library but not bitwise-guaranteed across library versions; the SHA identity gate covers the original path and certificates cover the stable path.

With rho ~ 1e-7, F64 noise-floor singular values (~1e-16*smax) contribute ~s/rho ~ 1e-9 relative to D; the tight out-of-space certificate is therefore against the FULL sample space (implementation check), while energy outside the R1-criterion CAL subspace is reported as a diagnostic for both solvers.

R1 documentation errors (seed 43->42, overstated Q1-replay wording, ICC high/4 aggregation wording) are corrected as a separate versioned doc update after this job; the frozen R1 publication snapshot is not modified.
